# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Root of a select. Like Base UI's Select.Root it has no look of its own: it
  # holds the Stimulus controller, and SelectInput inside it carries the value.
  class Select < Base
    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "select",
          controller: "ruby-ui--select"
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

module RubyUI
  # The list. A native popover (top layer) with role=listbox, positioned next
  # to the trigger by Floating UI; side:/align: pick the placement and
  # side_offset:/align_offset: the gap, as in shadcn's SelectContent. Like
  # shadcn's default (alignItemWithTrigger), it doesn't animate.
  class SelectContent < Base
    SIDES = %i[top right bottom left].freeze
    ALIGNS = %i[start center end].freeze

    # outlet_id: is accepted for backwards compatibility and ignored.
    def initialize(side: :bottom, side_offset: 4, align: :center, align_offset: 0, outlet_id: nil, **)
      @side = SIDES.include?(side.to_sym) ? side.to_sym : :bottom
      @side_offset = side_offset
      @align = ALIGNS.include?(align.to_sym) ? align.to_sym : :center
      @align_offset = align_offset
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs, &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        id: "select-content-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}",
        role: "listbox",
        tabindex: "-1",
        popover: "manual",
        data: {
          slot: "select-content",
          ruby_ui__select_target: "content",
          action: "keydown->ruby-ui--select#listKeydown",
          closed: "",
          side: @side,
          align: @align,
          preferred_side: @side,
          side_offset: @side_offset,
          align_offset: @align_offset
        },
        class: [
          "fixed inset-auto m-0 border-0 p-0 outline-none",
          "isolate z-50 min-w-36 w-(--anchor-width) max-h-(--available-height) origin-(--transform-origin)",
          "overflow-x-hidden overflow-y-auto rounded-md bg-popover text-popover-foreground shadow-md ring-1 ring-foreground/10"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

module RubyUI
  # A group of items, named by the SelectLabel inside it (role=group with
  # aria-labelledby, as Base UI's Select.Group).
  class SelectGroup < Base
    def initialize(id: nil, **)
      @id = id || "select-group-#{SecureRandom.hex(4)}"
      super(id: @id, **)
    end

    # The children are captured first, so aria-labelledby only points at a
    # SelectLabel that actually rendered.
    def view_template(&block)
      previous = context[:ruby_ui_select_group]
      names = context[:ruby_ui_select_group] = {label_id: "#{@id}-label"}
      body = block ? capture(&block) : ""
      group_attrs = names[:labelledby] ? mix({aria: {labelledby: names[:labelledby]}}, attrs) : attrs
      div(**group_attrs) { raw(safe(body)) }
    ensure
      context[:ruby_ui_select_group] = previous
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "group",
        data: {slot: "select-group"},
        class: "scroll-my-1 p-1"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The value carrier, like Base UI's hidden input: a real input (so name:,
  # value: and required: work with forms and FormField) kept out of sight, the
  # tab order and the accessibility tree.
  class SelectInput < Base
    def view_template
      input(**attrs)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        tabindex: "-1",
        autocomplete: "off",
        aria: {hidden: "true"},
        class: "sr-only",
        data: {
          ruby_ui__select_target: "input",
          ruby_ui__form_field_target: "input",
          action: "change->ruby-ui--form-field#onChange invalid->ruby-ui--form-field#onInvalid invalid->ruby-ui--select#focusTrigger"
        }
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # An option. Focus moves onto it (roving tabindex), as in Base UI's
  # Select.Item; the check on the right marks the selected one.
  class SelectItem < Base
    def initialize(value: nil, disabled: false, **)
      @value = value
      @disabled = disabled
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&)
      div(**attrs) do
        span(class: "flex flex-1 shrink-0 gap-2 whitespace-nowrap", &)
        indicator
      end
    end

    private

    def indicator
      span(class: "pointer-events-none invisible absolute right-2 size-4 items-center justify-center group-aria-selected/select-item:visible", aria: {hidden: "true"}) do
        svg(
          xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
          viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
          fill: "none",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          stroke_width: "2",
          stroke_linecap: "round",
          stroke_linejoin: "round",
          aria_hidden: "true",
          class: "pointer-events-none size-4"
        ) { |s| s.path(d: "M20 6 9 17l-5-5") }
      end
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        role: "option",
        tabindex: "-1",
        aria: {selected: "false", disabled: (@disabled ? "true" : nil)},
        data: {
          slot: "select-item",
          value: @value,
          disabled: (@disabled ? "" : nil),
          ruby_ui__select_target: "item",
          action: "click->ruby-ui--select#select pointermove->ruby-ui--select#hover"
        },
        class: [
          "group/select-item relative flex w-full cursor-default items-center gap-2 rounded-sm py-1.5 pr-8 pl-2 text-sm outline-hidden select-none",
          "focus:bg-accent focus:text-accent-foreground not-data-[variant=destructive]:focus:**:text-accent-foreground",
          "data-disabled:pointer-events-none data-disabled:opacity-50",
          "aria-disabled:pointer-events-none aria-disabled:opacity-50",
          "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
          "*:[span]:last:flex *:[span]:last:items-center *:[span]:last:gap-2"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  class SelectLabel < Base
    # Inside a SelectGroup, the first label names the group.
    def view_template(&)
      names = context[:ruby_ui_select_group]
      return div(**attrs, &) if names.nil? || (!attrs[:id] && names[:labelledby])

      id = attrs[:id] || names[:label_id]
      names[:labelledby] ||= id
      div(**attrs.merge(id: id), &)
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        # The group is named through aria-labelledby; the text itself is hidden.
        aria: {hidden: "true"},
        data: {slot: "select-label"},
        class: "px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground"
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # The button that opens the list (Base UI's Select.Trigger with role=combobox).
  # size: :default (h-9) or :sm (h-8), as in shadcn's SelectTrigger.
  class SelectTrigger < Base
    SIZES = %i[default sm].freeze

    def initialize(size: :default, **)
      @size = SIZES.include?(size.to_sym) ? size.to_sym : :default
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      button(**attrs) do
        block&.call
        icon
      end
    end

    private

    def icon
      svg(
        xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
        viewbox: "0 0 24 24",
        fill: "none",
        stroke: "currentColor",
        stroke_width: "2",
        stroke_linecap: "round",
        stroke_linejoin: "round",
        aria_hidden: "true",
        class: "pointer-events-none size-4 text-muted-foreground"
      ) { |s| s.path(d: "m6 9 6 6 6-6") }
    end

    def default_attrs
      {
        type: "button",
        role: "combobox",
        # aria-controls is set by the controller while the list is open.
        aria: {haspopup: "listbox", expanded: "false"},
        data: {
          slot: "select-trigger",
          size: @size,
          ruby_ui__select_target: "trigger",
          action: "click->ruby-ui--select#toggle keydown->ruby-ui--select#triggerKeydown"
        },
        class: [
          "flex w-fit items-center justify-between gap-1.5 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent py-2 pr-2 pl-2.5 text-sm shadow-xs outline-none",
          "transition-[color,box-shadow] data-placeholder:text-muted-foreground",
          "focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50",
          "aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-3 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20",
          "dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50 dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40",
          "disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50",
          "aria-disabled:cursor-not-allowed aria-disabled:opacity-50 aria-disabled:pointer-events-none",
          "data-[size=default]:h-9 data-[size=sm]:h-8",
          "*:data-[slot=select-value]:line-clamp-1 *:data-[slot=select-value]:flex *:data-[slot=select-value]:items-center *:data-[slot=select-value]:gap-1.5",
          "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4"
        ]
      }
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

module RubyUI
  # Shows the selected item's text inside SelectTrigger, or placeholder: while
  # nothing is selected. The controller keeps it in sync with SelectInput.
  class SelectValue < Base
    def initialize(placeholder: nil, **)
      @placeholder = placeholder
      super(**)
    end

    def view_template(&block)
      span(**attrs) do
        value = block&.call
        value || @placeholder
      end
    end

    private

    def default_attrs
      {
        data: {
          slot: "select-value",
          ruby_ui__select_target: "value",
          placeholder_text: @placeholder
        },
        class: "flex flex-1 text-left"
      }
    end
  end
end

docs_markdown:
# Select

Displays a list of options for the user to pick from—triggered by a button.

## Usage

### Basic

```ruby
Select do
  SelectInput(name: "fruit")

  SelectTrigger(class: "w-56") do
    SelectValue(placeholder: "Select a fruit")
  end

  SelectContent do
    SelectGroup do
      SelectLabel { "Fruits" }
      SelectItem(value: "apple") { "Apple" }
      SelectItem(value: "banana") { "Banana" }
      SelectItem(value: "blueberry") { "Blueberry" }
      SelectItem(value: "grapes") { "Grapes" }
      SelectItem(value: "pineapple") { "Pineapple" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Pre-selected Item

```ruby
Select do
  SelectInput(name: "preselected_fruit", value: "banana")

  SelectTrigger(class: "w-56") do
    SelectValue(placeholder: "Select a fruit") { "Banana" }
  end

  SelectContent do
    SelectGroup do
      SelectLabel { "Fruits" }
      SelectItem(value: "apple") { "Apple" }
      SelectItem(value: "banana") { "Banana" }
      SelectItem(value: "blueberry") { "Blueberry" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Sizes

```ruby
div(class: "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2") do
  [:default, :sm].each do |size|
    Select do
      SelectInput()

      SelectTrigger(size: size, class: "w-40") do
        SelectValue(placeholder: size == :sm ? "Small" : "Default")
      end

      SelectContent do
        SelectGroup do
          SelectItem(value: "apple") { "Apple" }
          SelectItem(value: "banana") { "Banana" }
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
```

### Placement

```ruby
Select do
  SelectInput(name: "placement_fruit")

  SelectTrigger(class: "w-56") do
    SelectValue(placeholder: "Opens above, aligned to the start")
  end

  SelectContent(side: :top, align: :start, side_offset: 8) do
    SelectGroup do
      SelectItem(value: "apple") { "Apple" }
      SelectItem(value: "banana") { "Banana" }
      SelectItem(value: "blueberry") { "Blueberry" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Disabled

```ruby
Select do
  SelectInput(name: "disabled_fruit", value: "apple")

  SelectTrigger(disabled: true, class: "w-56") do
    SelectValue(placeholder: "Select a fruit") { "Apple" }
  end

  SelectContent do
    SelectGroup do
      SelectItem(value: "apple") { "Apple" }
    end
  end
end
```

### Disabled Items

```ruby
Select do
  SelectInput(name: "disabled_items_fruit")

  SelectTrigger(class: "w-56") do
    SelectValue(placeholder: "Select a fruit")
  end

  SelectContent do
    SelectGroup do
      SelectLabel { "Fruits" }
      SelectItem(value: "apple", disabled: true) { "Apple" }
      SelectItem(value: "banana") { "Banana" }
      SelectItem(value: "blueberry") { "Blueberry" }
      SelectItem(value: "grapes", disabled: true) { "Grapes" }
    end
  end
end
```
